points: Your site shows 11599 reviews, yet 0 of 30 ads carry that number, so buyers get no proof before the click. Put the count on every creative, then open two ads with a Syed Faraz quote about comfort.

Your site explains how orders ship, yet 0 of 30 ads mention shipping or delivery, so a first time buyer has to guess. Open new buyer ads with the delivery answer in line one and repeat it in every creative.
5 of your Shop now ads send buyers to the homepage, so a visitor has to search for the product the ad showed. Point each of those five to the exact product page the creative shows.
0 of 23 ads carry an offer, so a first time buyer has no reason to act today. Build three new ads around one first order offer or a bundle, and put that offer in line one of each creative.
